registry_boundary_reproducer.purpose: Reproduce the selector-unrelated malformed registry evidence that Beta 51 incorrectly treated as global label incompleteness.

historical_replay.contract: Run the exact shipped provider, dependency index, and helper-risk service offline; compare every sanitized v10 obligation and downstream profile as an order-independent multiset.

provenance.snapshot_equivalence_limitation: The persisted plan binds dependency generation 3. Current configurations and memberships were read later and cannot be cryptographically proven identical to the plan-time snapshot.
provenance.registry_boundary_limitation: The persisted obligations prove global label resolution was unavailable, but the raw plan-time registry record that caused the global completeness loss was not retained. The bounded unrelated invalid record reproduces that exact production boundary without claiming a captured household identity.
sanitization_process: Map automation, entity, group, person and label identities to deterministic pseudonyms.
Preserve Jinja syntax, whitespace, control flow, ordering, scalar types and candidate relationships.
Replace display-only notification and automation text before hashing.
Recompute every committed configuration, obligation and profile fingerprint after sanitization.
Do not invent label or group members; use bounded read-only Home Assistant results.
